5002:
** τακτός**, ή, όν,
(τάσσω) **ordered, prescribed**, τακτόν τι παρὰ τοῦ Κύρου παραγγέλλων {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Institutio Cyri (Cyropaedia)” 8.3.28}}; τ. ἀργύριον a **fixed** or **stated** sum, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.65; τ. χρήματα 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Leges” 746a}}; σῖτος τ. **a fixed quantity of** corn, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.16; τ. τροφὴν λαμβάνειν 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Leges” 909c, compare 2nd c.AD: Alexander Rhetor 141.6}}; δίκαι τ. **fixed** penalties, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Leges” 632b}}; ἐκφόριον τ. a **fixed** rent, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“PPetr.” 3p.250 (3rd c.BC)}}; τ. ὁδός a **prescribed** way, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 23.72; ἐν τ. ἡμέραις βουλεύεσθαι 4th c.BC: Aeschines Orator 2.109; ἐπὶ τὰ τ. ἔτη πέντε “POxy.” 101.10 (2nd c.AD)}}; κατά τινας χρόνους τ. {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 599b4.}} _adverb_ τακτῶς variant in {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD: Plotinus Philosophus 3.1.2.}}

5063:
** τεσσᾰρᾰκοντᾰ-ετής**, ές,
**forty years old**, {{NT+8th c.BC+|8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Opera et Dies” 441; τ. χρόνος NT.Act.7.23, 13.18; ἡλικία 2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 1.34}}:—_Attic dialect_ _feminine_ **τεττᾰρᾰκοντᾰέτις**, ιδος, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 460e}}: _masculine_ also **τεσσᾰρᾰκοντούτης**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 15.504, 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 11.1}}, (τεττ-) {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Herm.” 13.}}
5064:
** τέσσᾰρες**, οἱ, αἱ, τέσσαρα, τά,
_genitive_ ων: _dative_ τέσσαρσι (ν) {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.21, NT.Act.12.4, etc.}}; _poetry_ τέτρᾰσι {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Fragmenta” 188, 5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “O.” 8.68, +others}}, and in late Prose, as {{LXX+1st c.BC+|LXX.Judg.9.34, 1st c.BC-1st c.AD: Strabo Geographus 13.1.3, 2nd c.AD: Hermogenes Rhetor “περὶ μεθόδου δεινότητος” 29, 3rd c.AD: Alexander Aphrodisiensis Philosophus “in Aristotelis Topicorum libros octo commentaria - pars” 208.12, “in Sens.” 54.18, “PSI” 10.1126.9 (3rd c.AD)}}, variant in {{NT|NT.Act.11.5 (codex D)}}, and in good codices of {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “de Incessu Animalium” 704a11, +others, “Theologumena Arithmeticae” 19, etc.; also τέταρσι “SIG” 729.3 (Delph., 1st c.BC), “PSI” 9.1028.10 (1st c.AD)}}:—_Attic dialect_ **τέττᾰρες**, τέττᾰρα, _dative_ τέτταρσιν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Isocrates Orator 12.3}}; also τάρων (see. τάρες) for τεττάρω; Phocian _dative_ τεττάροις {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|“IG” 9(1).32.78 (Stiris, 2nd c.BC)}}:—_Ionic dialect_ and later Gr. **τέσσερες**, τέσσερα, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|“SIG” 57.25 (Milet., 5th c.BC), “Schwyzer” 289.120 (Rhodian, 2nd c.BC)}}, etc. (_dative_ τέσσερσι {{LXX+8th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 6.41, τεσσέρασιν “SIG” 633.98 (Milet., 2nd c.BC)), but τέσσαρες in 8th c.BC: Homerus Epicus, and “Schwyzer” 707 B 4 (Ephesus, 6th c.BC), etc.: codices of LXX have τέσσαρες (_nominative_ and _accusative_), τεσσάρων, τέσσαρσι, but τέσσερα(ς), τεσσεράκοντα}}; since however τέσσερα(ς) and τεσσεράκοντα, apart from _Ionic dialect_, are not common in Papyri before 2nd c.AD, the LXX autographs probably had τέσσαρα(ς) and τεσσαράκοντ; the form τέσσερα(ς) is here due to avoidance by the copyists of the sequence ε-α-α:—_Doric dialect_ **τέτορες**, τέτορα, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Opera et Dies” 698, 6th c.BC: Phocylides Lyricus 3, 4th-5th c.BC: Simonides Lyricus 91, 5th c.BC: Epicharmus Comicus 149, “SIG” 240 I 8 (Delph., 4th c.BC), +others, 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 14.16:}} —_Epic dialect_ (probably _Aeolic dialect_) **πίσῠρες** [ῐ] {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 5.70, 16.249, 3rd c.BC: Apollonius Rhodius Epicus 2.1110, 2nd c.BC: Nicander Epicus “Theriaca” 182; _accusative_ πίσῠρας 8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 22.111, 8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 15.680, +others, 3rd c.BC: Callimachus Epicus “Hymnus in Dianam” 105, “IGRom.” 4.360.26 (Pergam., 2nd c.AD)}}; _genitive_ πισύρων {{Refs 5th c.AD+|5th-6th c.AD: Damascius Philosophus “Vita Isidori” 290 (metrical?), probably in 5th c.AD(?): Hesychius Legal icographus}}; _dative_ πισύρεσσι, πισύροισι, -ῃσι, -αις, {{Refs 4th c.AD+|4th-5th c.AD(?): Nonnus Epicus “Dionysiaca” 16.119, 38.176, 236, 39.377, “Anthologia Graeca” 14.7.4}}: _Aeolic dialect_ also **πέσῠρες**, _neuter_ **πέσῠρα** {{Refs|“epigram Gr.” 988.6 (from Balbilla)}}; and **πέσσῠρες**, **πέσσῠρα**, {{Refs 5th c.AD+|5th c.AD(?): Hesychius Legal icographus}}:—_Boeotian dialect_ **πέττᾰρες**, α (which see):—**four**, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 9.335, etc.}}; διὰ τεττάρων the musical interval of **the fourth**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Damoxenus Comicus 2.55, etc.}}; τὰ τέσσαρα **the four simple bodies** of Empedocles, {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD: Plotinus Philosophus 6.2.2}}; **the four kinds of quality** or four Aristotelian senses of ποιόν, {{Refs|[prev. author] 6.1.10}}; **the four cardinal principles** of Epicurus (compare τετραφάρμακος), {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Herc.” 1251.11}}. (Cf. Sanskrit _catvā´ras_ (_accusative_ **catúras**), Latin _quattuor_, Lithuanian _keturì_, etc.: I.-{{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus}} **q[uglide]et[uglide]or**-.)
5065:
** τεσσᾰρεσκαιδέκᾰτος**,
_Ionic dialect_ **τεσσερ-**, η, ον, **fourteenth**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.84, “PEleph.” 1.1 (4th c.BC), “SIG” 633.27 (Milet., 2nd c.BC), 2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 1.20, etc.}}: also **τεσσᾰρασκαιδέκατος**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|“JRS” 17.34 (Cyrene, 1st c.BC)}}; **τεττ-**, {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|“Inscription Délos” 1408 A ii 12 (2nd c.BC)}}; compare τεσσαρακαιδέκατος.
5070:
** τετρᾰκισ-χίλιοι** [ῑλ], αι,
a, **four thousand**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 2.9, +others; by tmesis, τετράκις γὰρ χίλιοι 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 6.31}}: _Laconian dialect_ **τετρᾰκινχήλιοι** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|“IG” 5(1).1 (Sparta, 5th c.BC)}}; Cyrenaic **τετρᾰκιχήλιοι** {{Refs|“Abh.Berl.Akad.” 1925(5).25}}; _Boeotian dialect_ **πετρᾰκισχείλιη** _feminine_, which see).
5072:
** τετρᾰ-μηνος**, ον,
(μήν) **of four months, lasting four months**, σπονδαί {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 5.63}}; τετράμηνοι ὀχεύουσι **at four months old**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 545b1}}; τετράμηνον **for a space of four months**,{{Refs 3rd c.BC+|[prev. work] 573a13, compare “PCair.Zen.” 291, 498 (3rd c.BC), etc.}}; ἡ πρώτη τ. {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“SIG” 410.4 (Erythrae, 3rd c.BC)}}; so τετράμηνα {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “ἀφορισμοί” 4.1: _Boeotian dialect_ πετράμεινος (which see).}}
5073:
** τετρᾰ-πλόος**, η, ον,
_contraction_ **τετρᾰ-πλοῦς**, ῆ, οῦν, **fourfold**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Lucullus” 2; τοῦ τετραπλοῦ μισθοῦ “PSI” 9.1055.13 (3rd c.AD)}}; τὸ τ., ={τετραμοιρία}, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Anabasis” 7.6.7; ἀποδίδωμι τετραπλοῦν NT.Luke.19.8}}. _adverb_ **-πλῶς**{{LXX|LXX.3Ki.6.31(33). (Cf. ἁπλόος.)}}
5075:

5077:
** τεφρ-όω**,
**burn to ashes**, {{NT+3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Lycophron Tragicus 227; πόλεις NT.2Pet.2.6}}:—_middle_, {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Nicander Epicus “Alexipharmaca” 534}}:—_passive_, **to be burnt to ashes**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “de Igne” 20, “Anthologia Graeca” 5.187 (1st c.AD: Leonidas Alexandrinus Epigrammaticus)}}; **to be covered with ashes**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd-3rd c.AD: Dio Cassius Historicus 66.21.}}
